memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- NAFLD: status: mild steatosis on prior ultrasound, asymptomatic; plan: continue silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD, lifestyle modification.
- Vitamin B12 deficiency: status: low serum B12, mild fatigue; plan: start methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, recheck in 3 months.
- IBS: status: intermittent bloating, occasional loose stools; plan: mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS, diet advice.
Weight 55 kg, waist 78 cm (<80 cm cut‑off).
Diet advice: breakfast – low‑fat, high‑fibre; lunch – balanced carbs‑protein; dinner – light, early.
Due: HbA1c – 2025-07-15.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Abdominal ultrasound: Liver shows mild diffuse steatosis, homogeneous echotexture, no focal lesions. Portal vein normal. Gallbladder wall thickness 2 mm, no stones. Spleen normal size. No ascites. Impression: NAFLD, grade 1 steatosis.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: "I’ve been feeling bloated after lunch and sometimes have loose stools in the evening. My energy is okay but I still get tired after work."
